text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Aoharu Cup is divided into the 
"Pre-Season" and the "Main Tournament." 
For now, let's aim for the top ranks in 
the Pre-Season.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, the Aoharu Cup is a team 
competition. Naturally, we need to recruit 
team members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Call out to support members and perform 
well in preseason races to get them 
interested in joining the team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, we also need to come up with 
a team name. With Tazuna's encouraging 
words in heart, I renewed my resolve to do 
my best.
